status: Post-hoc, unblinded preliminary review. Not independent expert gold labels.

rubric.persona_reply: Core goal: follow the explicit topic change to music in the target language. Style, exact length and full conversational naturalness are not scored.
rubric.persona_word_gloss: Core goal: provide usable contextual word meanings with valid nonoverlapping source spans. Pronunciation and romanization are separate dimensions.
rubric.coach_feedback: Core goal: correct the deliberate error with source-aligned replacements that preserve meaning; additional harmful replacements fail. Invalid JSON is not assessable as a usable correction.
rubric.reply_assistance: Core goal: offer two useful reply choices to the partner's referent-clarification question. Repeating the question is partial at best. Optional fictional draft details are not automatically factual hallucinations.
